Raised a €1M ($1.1M) seed extension in Oct 2015 led by Caixa Capital (total €1.5M then, so ~€0.5M in earlier undisclosed seed money), a $5.1M Series A in Aug 2017 led by EQT Ventures with Seedcamp, and a $15M Series B in Sep 2022 led by Bright Pixel. amount_raised ($21.2M) leaves out the earlier ~€0.5M.

funding_notes: hole19golf.com, Lisbon, Portugal; golf GPS/scorecard app founded 2011 by Anthony Douglas; Seedcamp 2013. Forbes Portugal: White Star Capital and e42 invested €170k after Seedcamp (2013); second round 2014 with Faber Ventures of 'close to €300k' (amount left null as approximate); founder also used family/friends money, a €25k creative-industries prize and applied for €500k QREN funding (QREN grant receipt implied, not explicitly confirmed). Observador later cited ~€2.2M invested by Faber, Caixa Capital, White Star, e42, Seedcamp and angels. The Aug 2017 ~€3.47M round (Caixa Capital, Kibo, White Star, Faber) is sourced only from tracker-style sites (bouncewatch/indexed; amounts vary $1.7M–$4.1M) — no reputable press article found. White Star Capital lists Hole19 as an active portfolio company. Total left blank given conflicting/approximate figures.
